name: babygen
description: Generator for the Wind Wave Pokemon (baby Meowth, Zubat, Litwick and Frillgator): Blockbench models, textures, animations and Cobblemon data

scripts.build: node build.js babymeowth && node build.js babyzubat && node build.js babylitwick && node build.js frillgator
scripts.verify: node roundtrip.js babymeowth -:0 ground_idle:0.7 cry:0.45 sleep:1 faint:1.5 && node roundtrip.js babyzubat -:0 air_idle:0.13 sleep:0 cry:0.35 && node roundtrip.js babylitwick -:0 ground_idle:0.7 cry:0.4 special:0.6 faint:1.4 && node roundtrip.js frillgator -:0 ground_idle:0.7 sleep:1 cry:0.5 faint:1.6
scripts.previews: node gif.js babymeowth out/gif_babymeowth && node gif.js babyzubat out/gif_babyzubat && node gif.js babylitwick out/gif_babylitwick && node gif.js frillgator out/gif_frillgator && node showcase.js && python3 previews.py
